entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. I've had it for a few weeks and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference! I don't have time to explain my life story. I don't like it. Your website says 90 days, so just process the return. Are you going to do it or not?
Of course. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I have your email address, please?
It's angrycustomer@email.com. And you'd better find it.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order. The VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 15th, so about 23 days ago. Honestly, for a wearable device like this, we're usually very strict because of hygiene concerns.
What are you implying? That it's too late? Your official policy is 90 days! Are you trying to get out of it? I swear, I will file a complaint and talk to a manager right now!

No, sir, not at all! My apologies, I was just thinking aloud. Proper sanitation is a big focus for us, but let me check the definitive policy tied to your purchase... Please hold just one more second.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've pulled up the knowledge base, and you are absolutely correct. My mistake. It says right here your item is covered by our 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe, so I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund immediately.
Oh. Well... good. That's what I thought. You guys should really know your own rules.

You're right, and I apologize for the confusion. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next 15 minutes. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, affix the label, and drop it at the post office.
And I'll get a full refund?
Yes, a full refund to your original payment method, processed as soon as our warehouse receives and inspects the item.
Alright, fine. That's all I wanted. Thank you.
You are very welcome. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
